DELIED — Complete Website Product Requirements Document (PRD)

Project: DELIED Fashion E-commerce & Business Management Platform
Product Type: Multi-role E-commerce + Reseller + Wholesale + Company ERP
Target Market: Bangladesh
Currency: BDT (৳), with optional USD support
Languages: Bangla and English
Platforms: Responsive Web, Mobile Web, PWA-ready
Document Version: 1.0

⸻

1. Project Overview

DELIED will be a complete fashion e-commerce and business management ecosystem.

The platform will connect customers, resellers, wholesale buyers, company staff, shareholders, moderators, marketers and administrators through one centralized system.

Each user will have a separate dashboard based on their assigned role, while all modules will use a shared database and centralized backend.

Main objectives

* Sell fashion products online.
* Provide reseller and wholesale purchasing facilities.
* Manage products, inventory and orders.
* Track company expenses and product costing.
* Manage employees and company operations.
* Provide shareholder reporting.
* Manage customer support and marketing.
* Monitor the complete business from one Admin Panel.

⸻

2. User Roles & Permissions

The platform will support eight main user roles.

1. Customer
2. Reseller
3. Wholesale Buyer
4. Super Admin
5. Company Staff
6. Shareholder
7. Moderator
8. Marketer

Each role must have independent permissions.

2.1 Customer

Dashboard modules:

* Dashboard Overview
* My Orders
* Order Tracking
* Wishlist
* Shopping Cart
* My Addresses
* Payment History
* Return & Exchange
* Product Reviews
* Notifications
* Support Tickets
* My Profile

2.2 Reseller

Dashboard modules:

* Reseller Dashboard
* Product Catalogue
* Reseller Price
* Suggested Retail Price
* Custom Selling Price
* Share Product
* Referral Links
* My Customers
* My Orders
* Sales Report
* Profit Report
* Commission
* Wallet
* Withdraw Request
* Payment History
* Reseller Membership
* Support

Business rules:

* Admin can approve or reject reseller applications.
* Reseller prices are controlled by configurable pricing rules.
* Resellers can select permitted selling prices.
* Profit is calculated automatically.
* Commission and withdrawal records must be auditable.

2.3 Wholesale Buyer

Dashboard modules:

* Wholesale Dashboard
* Wholesale Catalogue
* Bulk Order
* Minimum Order Quantity
* Quantity-based Pricing
* Wholesale Cart
* Invoices
* Payment History
* Delivery Tracking
* Order History
* Support

Business rules:

* Admin can define minimum order quantities.
* Wholesale prices can vary by quantity.
* Different customers can have different approved price tiers.
* Bulk orders require confirmation before fulfillment.

2.4 Super Admin

Admin modules:

* Main Dashboard
* User Management
* Customer Management
* Reseller Management
* Wholesale Management
* Product Management
* Category Management
* Inventory Management
* Order Management
* Payment Management
* Coupon Management
* Company Costing
* Production Management
* Shareholder Management
* Employee Management
* Marketing Management
* Moderator Management
* Live Chat Management
* Reports & Analytics
* Website Settings
* Payment Gateway Settings
* User Roles & Permissions
* Audit Logs
* Backup & Restore

Only authorized Super Admins can assign privileged roles.

2.5 Company Staff

Dashboard modules:

* Company Overview
* Products
* Raw Materials
* Production
* Suppliers
* Purchases
* Inventory
* Expenses
* Sales
* Product Costing
* Accounts & Finance
* Employees (permission-controlled)
* Reports
* Documents

Staff access must be restricted by department and assigned permissions.

2.6 Shareholder

Dashboard modules:

* Shareholder Overview
* My Shares
* Ownership Percentage
* Share Register
* Company Performance
* Approved Financial Reports
* Dividend History
* Company Announcements
* Meeting Documents
* Profile

Shareholders must only access information explicitly approved for their role.

2.7 Moderator

Dashboard modules:

* Moderator Dashboard
* Live Chat
* Assigned Conversations
* Support Tickets
* Customer Complaints
* Return & Exchange Requests
* Product Reviews
* FAQ Management
* Escalated Cases
* Activity History

2.8 Marketer

Dashboard modules:

* Marketing Dashboard
* Campaign Management
* Affiliate Links
* Coupon Management
* Marketing Content
* Social Media Campaigns
* Advertising Expenses
* Conversion Reports
* Sales Attribution
* Commission Reports

⸻

3. Public Website — Frontend

Main Navigation

* Home
* Shop
* Categories
* New Arrivals
* Best Sellers
* Winter Collection
* About Us
* Contact
* Search
* Wishlist
* Cart
* Account

1. Announcement Bar
2. Header & Navigation

5. Best Selling Products
6. Featured Categories
7. Winter Collection
8. Promotional Banner
9. Recommended Products
10. Customer Reviews
11. Brand Introduction
12. Newsletter Subscription
13. Footer

Shop Page

* Price Filter
* Size Filter
* Color Filter
* Availability Filter
* Sorting

* Product Name

* Available Colors

Payment Methods

Additional Pages

⸻

4. Product & Inventory Management

Product fields:

* Product Name
* SKU
* Category
* Description
* Product Images
* Size
* Color
* Regular Price
* Discount Price
* Wholesale Price
* Reseller Price
* Stock Quantity
* Low Stock Threshold
* Product Status

Inventory functions:

* Stock In
* Stock Out
* Stock Adjustment
* Stock Transfer
* Purchase Records
* Sales Deduction
* Return Stock
* Damaged Stock
* Inventory History

Every stock movement must have a recorded reason and responsible user.

⸻

5. Reseller & Wholesale Pricing Engine

The system must support multiple price levels.

Example:

Price Type	Example
Production Cost	৳600
Wholesale Price	৳750
Reseller Price	৳850
Suggested Retail Price	৳1,100
Customer Selling Price	৳1,100

These values are illustrative and must be configurable.

The system should calculate:

* Product Cost
* Wholesale Margin
* Reseller Margin
* Customer Discount
* Reseller Profit
* Company Gross Profit

Pricing rules must prevent unauthorized prices below the permitted minimum.

⸻

6. Company Costing & ERP

Product Costing

Each product should support:

* Fabric Cost
* Accessories Cost
* Printing Cost
* Label Cost
* Packaging Cost
* Labour Cost
* Production Overhead
* Other Costs

Formula:

Total Production Cost = Raw Materials + Labour + Packaging + Production Overhead + Other Production Costs.

The system must prevent duplicate expense counting.

Finance Modules

* Income
* Expenses
* Cash Accounts
* Bank Accounts
* Accounts Receivable
* Accounts Payable
* Supplier Payments
* Customer Payments
* Employee Salaries
* Profit & Loss
* Balance Sheet
* Cash Flow

All financial transactions must have a unique reference and audit history.

⸻

7. Order Management

Order statuses:

* Pending
* Confirmed
* Processing
* Ready to Ship
* Shipped
* Delivered
* Cancelled
* Return Requested
* Returned
* Refunded

Admin functions:

* View Orders
* Update Order Status
* Assign Delivery
* Print Invoice
* Record Payment
* Manage Returns
* Export Orders

Customer and reseller order histories must remain separated by ownership and access permissions.

⸻

8. Live Chat & 24/7 Support

Features:

* Live Chat Widget
* Agent Assignment
* Conversation History
* Quick Replies
* Internal Notes
* Support Tickets
* Priority Levels
* Escalation
* Agent Availability
* Shift Management
* Offline Message Collection
* Response Time Reports

The system must support scheduled shifts and transparent offline messaging. A 24/7 label must not imply staffed support when no agent is available.

⸻

9. Shareholder Management

Admin functions:

* Create Shareholder Account
* Record Share Allocation
* Update Share Register
* Record Approved Dividend
* Publish Financial Reports
* Publish Announcements
* Manage Meeting Documents

Share allocation and dividend calculations must be based on approved company records, not editable dashboard figures.

⸻

10. Marketing & Affiliate System

Features:

* Campaign Creation
* Affiliate Links
* Coupon Codes
* Campaign Start and End Dates
* Referral Attribution
* Order Conversion Tracking
* Marketing Expenses
* Campaign Performance
* Commission Calculation

The system must prevent duplicate or fraudulent commission attribution.

⸻

11. Notifications

Notification channels:

* Website Notifications
* Email
* SMS (configurable)
* Optional WhatsApp integration

Events:

* New Order
* Payment Received
* Order Status Updated
* Reseller Approval
* Withdrawal Update
* Low Stock
* New Support Ticket
* Campaign Update
* Company Announcement

Users must be able to manage notification preferences where appropriate.

⸻

12. UI/UX Design System

Design Direction

Premium Fashion + Modern Business Dashboard.

Recommended Primary Palette

Token	Color	HEX
Primary	Royal Indigo	#4F24E8
Secondary	Deep Navy	#171936
Background	White	#FFFFFF
Surface	Soft Lavender	#F5F3FF
Border	Light Gray	#E5E7EB
Primary Text	Dark Navy	#171936
Secondary Text	Slate Gray	#71758A
Success	Emerald	#16A34A
Warning	Amber	#F59E0B
Error	Red	#DC2626

Frontend Styling

* Luxury editorial layout
* Large product photography
* Spacious product cards
* Minimal navigation
* Clear product prices
* Consistent typography
* Smooth hover and transition effects

Backend Styling

* Dark Navy Sidebar
* White Content Area
* Soft Lavender Highlights
* Clean Data Tables
* Analytics Charts
* Consistent Status Badges
* Responsive Dashboard Cards

Responsive Requirements

Desktop:

* Full sidebar
* Multi-column dashboard
* Expanded tables

Tablet:

* Collapsible navigation
* Adaptive cards
* Horizontal table scrolling

Mobile:

* Drawer navigation
* Single-column cards
* Touch-friendly controls
* Mobile order management
* Bottom navigation where appropriate

⸻

13. Technical Requirements

The final technology stack must be selected before implementation.

Recommended architecture:

* Frontend: Modern responsive component-based framework
* Backend: Secure API-based application
* Database: Relational database
* Storage: Secure product image and document storage
* Authentication: Secure session/token-based authentication
* Payments: Bangladesh-supported payment gateway integrations
* Hosting: Production-ready Linux hosting or cloud server

The application must use a centralized backend and shared data model.

All privileged operations must be enforced server-side. Hiding a menu item is not sufficient security.

Core Technical Requirements

* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Secure Password Hashing
* Input Validation
* CSRF Protection
* XSS Protection
* SQL Injection Protection
* Rate Limiting
* Secure File Uploads
* Audit Logs
* Automated Backups
* Database Transactions
* Payment Verification
* Error Monitoring

⸻

14. Reports & Analytics

Admin reports:

* Total Sales
* Total Orders
* Total Customers
* Reseller Performance
* Wholesale Performance
* Product Performance
* Inventory Report
* Expense Report
* Gross Profit
* Net Profit
* Marketing Performance

Company reports:

* Production Cost
* Raw Material Usage
* Supplier Payments
* Cash Flow
* Profit & Loss
* Balance Sheet

Reports must support date filters and authorized export options.

⸻

15. Non-Functional Requirements

* Mobile-first responsive design
* Fast page loading
* Accessible color contrast
* Search-engine-friendly public pages
* Secure authentication
* Reliable payment processing
* Scalable database structure
* Clear error messages
* Consistent UI components
* Maintainable codebase
* Backup and recovery plan

⸻

16. Acceptance Criteria

The project will be considered ready for release when:

1. All eight roles can log in and access only authorized modules.
2. Customer orders can be placed and tracked.
3. Payment records are verified securely.
4. Reseller pricing and profit calculations work correctly.
5. Wholesale quantity-based pricing works correctly.
6. Inventory updates automatically after confirmed transactions.
7. Product costing reports calculate correctly.
8. Company financial reports reconcile with transaction records.
9. Shareholder access is limited to approved information.
10. Moderators can manage assigned support requests.
11. Marketers can track campaign attribution.
12. Admin can manage users, roles and permissions.
13. Mobile, tablet and desktop layouts work correctly.
14. Critical actions are recorded in audit logs.
15. Backup and recovery procedures are tested.

⸻

17. Development Phases

Phase 1 — Foundation

* Database Design
* Authentication
* User Roles & Permissions
* Design System
* Admin Base Layout

Phase 2 — E-commerce

* Homepage
* Shop
* Product Details
* Cart
* Checkout
* Payment
* Customer Dashboard

Phase 3 — Business Sales

* Reseller Dashboard
* Wholesale Dashboard
* Pricing Engine
* Commission
* Wallet
* Order Management

Phase 4 — Company ERP

* Inventory
* Raw Materials
* Production
* Product Costing
* Expenses
* Accounts & Finance
* Reports

Phase 5 — Other Roles

* Shareholder Portal
* Moderator Panel
* Marketer Dashboard
* Live Chat
* Notifications

Phase 6 — Testing & Launch

* Security Testing
* Payment Testing
* Role Permission Testing
* Mobile Testing
* Performance Testing
* Backup Testing
* Production Deployment

⸻

18. Final Deliverables

The development team must deliver:

* Complete Frontend Source Code
* Complete Backend Source Code
* Database Schema and Migrations
* All Eight Role Dashboards
* Responsive Admin Panel
* Payment Gateway Integration
* Live Chat System
* Company ERP Modules
* API Documentation
* Installation Guide
* Environment Configuration Guide
* Backup and Restore Instructions
* Testing Report
* Production Deployment Guide

### 🌐 System Architecture & Tech Stack

* **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router) with React 18 & TypeScript
* **Design System:** Tailwind CSS customized with the DELIED palette:
  * Primary: **Royal Indigo** (`#4F24E8`)
  * Secondary: **Deep Navy** (`#171936`)
  * Surface: **Soft Lavender** (`#F5F3FF`)
* **Database & ORM:** Prisma ORM with SQLite (`dev.db`) and 24 relational models
* **Dual Currency & Localization:** Real-time toggle between **BDT (৳)** and **USD ($)**, with **Bangla (বাংলা)** and **English** localization
* **Automated Testing:** Vitest test suite verifying mathematical pricing rules, costing formulas, and RBAC

---

### 👥 All 8 Dedicated Role Dashboards & Demo Logins

The application includes an **Instant One-Click Demo Login** on the [`/login`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/login/page.tsx) page (default password for manual entry is `delied123`):

| Role | Demo Email | Dedicated Dashboard Route | Key Implemented Capabilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Super Admin** | `admin@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/admin`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/admin/page.tsx) | Executive analytics, order workflow status commits, user approvals, inventory audit, DB backup & restore |
| **Retail Customer** | `customer@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/customer`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/customer/page.tsx) | Order history, live parcel tracking, wishlist, size exchange tickets, profile |
| **Boutique Reseller** | `reseller@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/reseller`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/reseller/page.tsx) | Custom selling price setter, automated margin & profit calculator, client dispatch, bKash wallet withdrawal |
| **Wholesale Buyer** | `wholesale@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/wholesale`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/wholesale/page.tsx) | Bulk catalogue, Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) validation, tier pricing (25%–35%), commercial invoices |
| **Company Staff** | `staff@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/staff`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/staff/page.tsx) | Raw materials inventory, production batches, 8-point costing formula editor, balance sheet & finance |
| **Shareholder** | `shareholder@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/shareholder`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/shareholder/page.tsx) | Equity shares (15%), approved dividend payouts, audited financial statements, AGM minutes |
| **Moderator** | `moderator@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/moderator`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/moderator/page.tsx) | Live customer care chat inbox, dispute management, return & exchange ticket resolution |
| **Growth Marketer** | `marketer@delied.com` | [`/dashboard/marketer`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/marketer/page.tsx) | Campaign creation, affiliate UTM links, order conversion attribution, 6.5% commission reporting |

---

### 🛍️ Public Website Modules & Features

1. **Homepage ([`page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/page.tsx)):** Includes all 13 required sections (Announcement Bar, Header, Hero Slider, New Arrivals, Best Sellers, Featured Categories, Winter Collection, Promotional Reseller Banner, Recommended Products, Customer Reviews, Brand Story, Newsletter, and Footer).
2. **Shop Catalog ([`shop/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/shop/page.tsx)):** Category filters, price range slider (৳500–৳10,000), size (S to XXL), color filters, and dynamic sorting.
3. **Product Details ([`product/[slug]/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx)):** Multi-image gallery, size/color selectors, live stock status, specifications sheet, customer reviews, Add to Cart, and instant Buy Now.
4. **Shopping Cart ([`cart/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/cart/page.tsx)):** Quantity modifiers, coupon validator (`DELIED10`, `EID2026`, `WELCOME50`), and delivery zone selector (Dhaka ৳60 vs Outside Dhaka ৳120).
5. **Checkout ([`checkout/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/checkout/page.tsx)):** All 64 Bangladesh Districts and Upazilas with automatic shipping calculation, Cash on Delivery, bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz options.
6. **Order Confirmation ([`order/[orderNumber]/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/order/[orderNumber]/page.tsx)):** Digital tax invoice with print support.
7. **Order Tracking ([`track-order/page.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/track-order/page.tsx)):** Visual multi-step progress stepper (Pending $\to$ Confirmed $\to$ Processing $\to$ Ready to Ship $\to$ Shipped $\to$ Delivered).
8. **Interactive Live Concierge Widget ([`LiveChatWidget.tsx`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/components/LiveChatWidget.tsx)):** Floating 24/7 support drawer with quick FAQs and real-time moderator messaging.
9. **Informational & Policy Pages:** [About Us](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/about/page.tsx), [Contact Us](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/contact/page.tsx), [FAQ](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/faq/page.tsx), [Returns Policy](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/returns/page.tsx), [Shipping Policy](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/shipping/page.tsx), [Privacy Policy](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/privacy/page.tsx), and [Terms & Conditions](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/src/app/terms/page.tsx).

---

### ⚙️ Pricing & ERP Costing Engines

* **Total Production Cost Equation:**
  $$\text{Total Production Cost} = \text{Fabric} + \text{Accessories} + \text{Printing} + \text{Labels} + \text{Packaging} + \text{Labour} + \text{Overhead} + \text{Other}$$
* **Reseller Rule:** $\text{Base Reseller Price} \le \text{Selling Price} \le 1.30 \times \text{Suggested MSRP}$. Profits are calculated automatically and credited to the wallet upon delivery.
* **Wholesale Bulk Tiers:** Automated MOQ validation and volume tier discounts (Tier 1 standard, Tier 2 $+3\%$, Tier 3 $+7\%$).

---

### 🧪 Verification & Build Status

* **Unit & Integration Tests:** `npm test` runs 6 Vitest tests covering pricing rules, MOQ validation, RBAC guards, and Bangladesh shipping calculations (all passing).
* **Production Build:** `npm run build` compiled all 45 static and dynamic pages with 0 errors.

All deliverables and guides have been documented in [`README.md`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/README.md), [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [`docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md), and [`docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`](https://github.com/rsriduan/my-project/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md). 5. Reseller & Wholesale Pricing Engine

The system must support multiple price levels.

Example:

Price Type	Example
Production Cost	৳600
Wholesale Price	৳750
Reseller Price	৳850
Suggested Retail Price	৳1,100
Customer Selling Price	৳1,100

These values are illustrative and must be configurable.

The system should calculate:

* Product Cost
* Wholesale Margin
* Reseller Margin
* Customer Discount
* Reseller Profit
* Company Gross Profit

Pricing rules must prevent unauthorized prices below the permitted minimum.

6. Company Costing & ERP

Product Costing

Each product should support:

* Fabric Cost
* Accessories Cost
* Printing Cost
* Label Cost
* Packaging Cost
* Labour Cost
* Production Overhead
* Other Costs

Formula:

Total Production Cost = Raw Materials + Labour + Packaging + Production Overhead + Other Production Costs.

The system must prevent duplicate expense counting.

13. Technical Requirements

The final technology stack must be selected before implementation.

Recommended architecture:

* Frontend: Modern responsive component-based framework
* Backend: Secure API-based application
* Database: Relational database
* Storage: Secure product image and document storage
* Authentication: Secure session/token-based authentication
* Payments: Bangladesh-supported payment gateway integrations
* Hosting: Production-ready Linux hosting or cloud server

The application must use a centralized backend and shared data model.

All privileged operations must be enforced server-side. Hiding a menu item is not sufficient security.

Core Technical Requirements

* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Secure Password Hashing
* Input Validation
* CSRF Protection
* XSS Protection
* SQL Injection Protection
* Rate Limiting
* Secure File Uploads
* Audit Logs
* Automated Backups
* Database Transactions
* Payment Verification
* Error Monitoring

16. Acceptance Criteria

The project will be considered ready for release when:

1. All eight roles can log in and access only authorized modules.
2. Customer orders can be placed and tracked.
3. Payment records are verified securely.
4. Reseller pricing and profit calculations work correctly.
5. Wholesale quantity-based pricing works correctly.
6. Inventory updates automatically after confirmed transactions.
7. Product costing reports calculate correctly.
8. Company financial reports reconcile with transaction records.
9. Shareholder access is limited to approved information.
10. Moderators can manage assigned support requests.
11. Marketers can track campaign attribution.
12. Admin can manage users, roles and permissions.
13. Mobile, tablet and desktop layouts work correctly.
14. Critical actions are recorded in audit logs.
15. Backup and recovery procedures are tested.
